correctness.rationale: An existential witness tuple has u<=k distinct values occupying t<=u equivalence classes. Among at least 2k+2 elements, >t+1 outsiders yield two with the same E-incidence profile to witnesses. The induced witness-plus-pair structure preserves every atomic type of two universally quantified variables; replacing this pair by s>=2 equivalent-profile points preserves pair types, including E(b,c) true (one class) and false (distinct outsider singletons). This builds every n>=k+2. Conversely a formula forces k distinct marked classes of sizes 1 or 2 and at most one outsider, giving precisely {k,...,2k+1}; for k=0, forall y,z(y=z) gives {1}. Independent enumeration checked all equivalence partitions up to 6 vertices and the cloning/pair-type premise. This is an all-k proof, not an inference from finite tests.
